question: In a certain code language, 'LUNCH' is written as 'NWPEJ', and 'FAITH' is written as 'HCKVJ'. How will 'SPACE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is: Letter + 2.

'LUNCH' is written as 'NWPEJ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cd73316f6fd16c7aedc5c65176c002c567452ce45b7e230a34fc9a3bc66fd18.png] 

'FAITH' is written as 'HCKVJ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/885f39b2e1eca84991d80f28c4c20507307b8015e248d65b210b33d765001f84.png] 

Similarly, for 'SPACE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/554e92516a0d2c2ca02f28813f8b7929df647c069366d20e0b31615f61f80b58.png] 

So, 'SPACE' will be written as 'URCEG'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
